entries.message: a list of 47 demo slugs (metaball, magnet-spring, swipe-cards, ...): derive it from allDemos() or generate it, so adding a demo cannot leave it stale
state noSubpage is never read in Demos: remove it (it is still written and recomputed on every commit)
PressableScale is 40 x 40 pt, under 44 pt: add padding, or -exact-hit-slop="2px" (grows the hit area, paints nothing)
dismiss plays haptic("impact-light") and is a PressableScale press: pressto's global haptic already plays on that press, so the two stack (toast, clerk-toast, floating-modal fixed exactly this)
